name: Compute Cluster S63: Trend Identification Indicators
description: Tests: ichimoku(p_tenkan, p_kijun, p_senkou_b), alligator(jaw, teeth, lips), vortex(period), qqe(avg_period, smooth_period, width_factor). Multi-line outputs, trend state classification.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S63: Trend Identification Indicators
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# === ICHIMOKU ===
ichi = ichimoku(high, low, close, p_tenkan=9, p_kijun=26, p_senkou_b=52)
tenkan = ichi.tenkan
kijun = ichi.kijun
senkou_a = ichi.senkou_a
senkou_b = ichi.senkou_b

# === ALLIGATOR ===
gator = alligator(jaw=13, teeth=8, lips=5)(close)
jaw = gator.jaw
teeth = gator.teeth
lips = gator.lips

# === VORTEX ===
vtx = vortex(period=14)(high, low, close)
vi_plus = vtx.plus_indicator
vi_minus = vtx.minus_indicator

# === QQE ===
q = qqe(avg_period=14, smooth_period=5, width_factor=4.236)(close)
qqe_line = q.result
qqe_long = q.long_line
qqe_short = q.short_line

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Ichimoku Cloud',
    category='Trend',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Tenkan', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Kijun', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Senkou A', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Senkou B', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(tenkan, kijun, senkou_a, senkou_b))

xy_lines(
    title='Alligator (Jaw/Teeth/Lips)',
    category='Trend',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Jaw (13)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Teeth (8)', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Lips (5)', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(jaw, teeth, lips))

xy_lines(
    title='Vortex Indicator',
    category='Trend',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VI+', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VI-', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(vi_plus, vi_minus))

xy_lines(
    title='QQE',
    category='Trend',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='QQE Line', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Long Line', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Short Line', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(qqe_line, qqe_long, qqe_short))
